title: Language Across Articulation: Meaning, Translation, and Epistemic Accountability in Structura Reditus
object_of_study: Accountable preservation of intellectual responsibility across changed articulations, translation, interpretation and semantic compression.
main_question: How can expressive and interpretive flexibility coexist with accountable preservation of what an articulation is doing?
